title: 参照画像は「画像1を唯一のキャラクター参照」と明記し、顔・目・虹彩・髪型/色・衣装・体格・シルエット・キャラカラーを最優先で固定して全編同一人物を維持する
content:
参照画像は「画像1を唯一のキャラクター参照」と明記し、顔・目・虹彩・髪型/色・衣装・体格・シルエット・キャラカラーを最優先で固定して全編同一人物を維持する  
参照画像からは背景/部屋/家具/ポーズ/画角/フレーミング/文字/設定表レイアウトを映像へ持ち込まないように禁止事項として書く  
変化を許可する要素（表情・視線・口元・ポーズ・呼吸・自然な髪/衣装の揺れ）を列挙し、それ以外（平均化・特徴混合・衣装交換・別人化・複製/クローン・追加人物）を禁止してキャラ崩れを抑える  
登場人物は参照キャラ1人だけと明記し、追加人物や複製を禁止して人数ブレを防ぐ  
敵は「一体だけの同じ黒い天空ドラゴン」と固定し、色（黒曜石）・発光線（細いシアン）・瞳（金）・顔つき/体格/輪郭を全編維持、別種化や抽象化や分身化を禁止する  
流血・傷口・切断を描かないと明記して過激表現や破綻を避ける  
武器は名称込みで一本に固定し（AERIAL RESCUE AXE／空巡救援斧）、形状ディテールを列挙して同一構造のまま動くよう指定する  
武器の破綻防止として、複製・分離・枝分かれ・別武器化・部品交換・柄の曲がり・先端だけの独立回転を禁止し、両手と柄の接触維持を指示する  
レンダリング指定として「細い色付き輪郭線＋2〜3段セル影＋透明感のある中間影」「素材別の鋭い多層ハイライト」を明記し、太い黒輪郭/単層セル影/汎用3D顔/プラスチックCG/低密度背景/半写実〜写実/画風混在を禁止する  
背景は人物より一段低彩度に抑え、ドラゴンのシアンは補助色に限定するなど配色ルールを明文化して色ブレを抑える  
カメラは「一続きに見える低い追走ショット」と指定し、開始位置・被写体配置（キャラ/接触点/遠景尖塔を対角線）・画角変化（ミディアムワイド→膝上ミディアム）を具体的に書いてカメラ挙動を制御する  
前景遮蔽（前爪や支柱が数フレームだけレンズ前を横切る）を指示しつつ「遮蔽中も動きを切らない」と書いてワンカット感を維持する  
アクションの因果を安定させるため、各打撃を「接触前に形状維持→指定部位が直接接触→接触瞬間だけ短い火花/反動→その後にだけ相手の向き/位置が変化」の順で指定し、接触前破壊や遠隔衝撃を禁止する  
連撃は「前の反発が次の攻撃の始動になる一続き」と定義し、構え直し/握り直し/溜め直し/停止/決めポーズを禁止してテンポを保つ  
音要素を限定（風・足音・風切り・短い硬質接触音・衣装擦れのみ）し、台詞/声/BGM/文字/字幕/ロゴ/透かしを入れないと明記する  
終端は「動きの途中で切る」と指定し、更新された前後関係・人物サイズ・視線方向・背景消失軸を保ったままカットして不自然な静止終わりを避ける

The reference image must explicitly state “Image 1 as the sole character reference,” and the face, eyes, iris, hairstyle/color, outfit, body type, silhouette, and character color must be locked with top priority so the same person is maintained throughout.  
From the reference image, prohibit carrying over the background/room/furniture/pose/camera angle/framing/text/settings-table layout into the video.  
List the elements allowed to change (expression, gaze, mouth, pose, breathing, natural movement of hair/clothing), and prohibit everything else (averaging, feature mixing, outfit swapping, turning into another person, duplication/cloning, additional people) to prevent character drift.  
Explicitly state that there is only one character in the scene, and prohibit extra people or duplicates to prevent fluctuations in the number of characters.  
Fix the enemy as “one and the same black sky dragon,” and maintain its color (obsidian), glowing lines (thin cyan), eyes (gold), facial features/body type/contour throughout; prohibit changing it into another species, abstracting it, or splitting it into copies.  
State that no blood, wounds, or dismemberment should be depicted to avoid excessive or broken visuals.  
Fix the weapon as a single named weapon, “AERIAL RESCUE AXE,” and specify its shape details so it moves as the same structure throughout.  
To prevent weapon breakage, prohibit duplication, separation, branching, turning into another weapon, part swapping, bending of the shaft, and independent rotation of only the tip, and instruct that both hands remain in contact with the shaft.  
For rendering, explicitly specify “thin colored outline lines + 2–3 layers of cel shading + translucent mid-shadows” and “sharp multilayer highlights by material,” and prohibit thick black outlines/single-layer cel shading/generic 3D faces/plastic CG/low-density backgrounds/semi-realistic to realistic styles/mixed art styles.  
Keep the background one step less saturated than the characters, and define color rules such as limiting the dragon’s cyan to an accent color to suppress color drift.  
Specify the camera as “a low tracking shot that appears continuous,” and control camera behavior by writing concrete details such as the starting position, subject arrangement (character/contact point/distant spire on a diagonal), and framing changes (medium-wide to knee-up medium).  
While instructing foreground occlusion (a front claw or support pillar crossing in front of the lens for a few frames), also write “do not cut the motion during occlusion” to preserve the one-shot feel.  
To stabilize action causality, specify each strike in the order “maintain shape before contact → direct contact at the designated part → brief spark/recoil only at the moment of contact → only then does the opponent’s orientation/position change,” and prohibit pre-contact destruction or remote impact.  
Define the combo as “a continuous sequence where the recoil from the previous hit becomes the start of the next attack,” and prohibit resetting stance/regripping/recharging/stopping/finishing poses to maintain tempo.  
Limit audio elements to wind, footsteps, whooshing air, short hard contact sounds, and clothing rustle only, and explicitly state that there should be no dialogue/voices/BGM/text/subtitles/logos/watermarks.  
For the ending, specify “cut in the middle of motion,” and cut while preserving the updated spatial relationship, character size, gaze direction, and background vanishing axis to avoid an unnatural still ending.

High-quality anime video. High-speed continuous combat in a sky-city fantasy. High-density 3D toon / cel look.

【Reference Image】

Do not carry over the background, room, furniture, pose, camera angle, framing, text, or settings-table layout from Image 1 into the video.
Only the expression, gaze, mouth, pose, breathing, and natural movement of hair and clothing may change. Do not average the face, mix features, swap outfits, turn the character into someone else, duplicate, clone, or add extra people. There is only one character: the one in Image 1.

Match the character colors in Image 1, and adjust only the reflected colors on the outfit, small decorative highlights, spark as an accent color, environmental light, airborne particles, and the accent colors of small maintenance lights or flags. Do not change the stage structure, weapon shape, the dragon’s obsidian color, the morning sky, or the platinum-colored city itself.

【Enemy】
The enemy is one and the same black sky dragon. Maintain its hard obsidian biological scales, thin cyan glowing lines, golden eyes, and the same facial features, body type, and contour throughout. Keep the black biological scales and body to the end; do not turn it into another species, a crystal body, a crystal statue, an abstract object, a humanoid, or a duplicate. Do not depict blood, wounds, or dismemberment.

【Weapon】
The weapon is only one “AERIAL RESCUE AXE.” It has a giant crescent-shaped axe blade in silver-white and translucent aqua, fine gold ornamentation, a circular ether core at the center of the axe head, a rescue spear tip at the top, a long navy leather-wrapped shaft, a single chain and tassel near the axe head, and a trident anchor on the butt end. The axe head, blade, spear tip, shaft, chain, tassel, and trident anchor are all one connected structure, and the entire weapon moves as a single unit.
Only the character holds the shaft with both hands, and both hands must remain in contact with the shaft. Do not allow duplication, separation, branching, turning into another weapon, part swapping, bending of the shaft, or independent rotation of only the tip. Only the tassel color may naturally match the character color in Image 1.

【Rendering】
Thin, delicate colored outline lines, two to three layers of cel shading, translucent mid-shadows. Apply sharp multilayer highlights by material to the face, hair, clothing, metal, translucent axe blade, ether core, and scales. The character’s main colors should follow Image 1, and the background should be kept one step less saturated. Limit the dragon’s cyan to an accent color.
Depict hair strands, clothing ornaments, metal fittings, chains, scales, and architectural decorations with high density, and distinguish the reflections and roughness of cloth, metal, translucent materials, and scales. The quality should be theatrical-feature-film-level key animation, premium compositing, transparent morning lighting, and dense background art.

Do not change into thick black outlines, flat single-layer cel shading, generic 3D anime faces, smooth plastic CG, low-density backgrounds, semi-realism, realism, dull colors, or mixed art styles.

【Location】
The stage is a wide route-maintenance deck in a platinum-colored aerial city. Place a pale stone floor with thin golden track lines running diagonally into the distance, thin maintenance pillars and handrails crossing near the lens, white arches in the midground, and white spires and a sea of clouds in the far distance in three layers: foreground, midground, and background. The floor track lines and white spires should create a clear vanishing axis of depth. Soft morning backlight, clear blue sky. Do not place any extra people or creatures.
【Contact Causality】
Every strike must first maintain the dragon’s black scales and armor shape before contact. Next, the specified part of the Aerial Rescue Axe must visibly and directly contact the specified scale. Only at the moment of contact should a brief spark and localized recoil occur. Only after that should the dragon’s overall orientation or grounding position change.

Do not create pre-contact destruction, remote impact, giant light spheres, circular barriers, substitute light bullets, or long shoving struggles.

As the character advances diagonally forward, the camera also enters the attack line, continuously enlarging the subject from medium-wide to knee-up medium. es.content:
La imagen de referencia debe indicar explícitamente “usar la imagen 1 como la única referencia del personaje”, y fijar con máxima prioridad el rostro, los ojos, el iris, el peinado/color de cabello, el vestuario, la complexión, la silueta y el color del personaje para mantener a la misma persona durante toda la pieza.  
Desde la imagen de referencia, prohíbe incorporar al video el fondo, la habitación, los muebles, la pose, el ángulo de cámara, el framing, el texto ni el layout de la tabla de configuración.  
Enumera los elementos que sí pueden cambiar (expresión, mirada, boca, pose, respiración, movimiento natural del cabello y la ropa) y prohíbe todo lo demás (promediado, mezcla de rasgos, cambio de vestuario, convertirlo en otra persona, duplicación/clonación, personajes adicionales) para evitar que el personaje se desmorone.  
Aclara que solo hay un personaje en escena: el personaje de referencia, y prohíbe personajes adicionales o duplicados para evitar variaciones en el número de personas.  
Fija al enemigo como “un único y mismo dragón negro del cielo”, manteniendo durante toda la obra el color (obsidiana), las líneas luminosas (cian fino), los ojos (dorados), el rostro, la complexión y el contorno, y prohíbe que se convierta en otra especie, se abstraiga o se divida en copias.  
Aclara que no se mostrarán sangre, heridas ni amputaciones para evitar expresiones extremas y fallos visuales.  
Fija el arma en una sola unidad con nombre incluido (AERIAL RESCUE AXE／空巡救援斧) y especifica sus detalles de forma para que se mueva manteniendo la misma estructura.  
Para evitar fallos del arma, prohíbe duplicación, separación, bifurcación, conversión en otra arma, intercambio de piezas, curvatura del mango y rotación independiente solo de la punta, e indica que ambas manos deben mantener contacto con el mango.  
Como especificación de render, deja claro “contorno fino y coloreado + cel shading de 2 a 3 niveles + sombras intermedias con transparencia” y “highlights nítidos y multicapa según el material”, y prohíbe contornos negros gruesos, cel shading de una sola capa, rostros 3D genéricos, CG plástico, fondos de baja densidad, semirrealismo a realismo y mezcla de estilos.  
Mantén el fondo con una saturación un nivel por debajo de la de los personajes, y aclara reglas de color como limitar el cian del dragón a un color secundario para reducir variaciones cromáticas.  
Especifica la cámara como “un travelling bajo que parece continuo”, y controla su comportamiento describiendo con detalle la posición inicial, la disposición de los sujetos (personaje/punto de contacto/aguja lejana en diagonal) y los cambios de encuadre (de medium wide a medium a la altura de las rodillas).  
Indica oclusión en primer plano (las garras delanteras o los pilares cruzan brevemente frente al lente) y añade “sin cortar el movimiento durante la oclusión” para mantener la sensación de plano secuencia.  
Para estabilizar la causalidad de la acción, especifica cada golpe en el orden “mantener la forma antes del contacto → la parte designada entra en contacto directo → solo en el instante del contacto hay un breve destello/reacción → solo después cambia la orientación/posición del oponente”, y prohíbe la destrucción antes del contacto y los impactos a distancia.  
Define la cadena de golpes como “una secuencia continua en la que el rebote anterior inicia el siguiente ataque”, y prohíbe reajustar la postura, volver a agarrar, recargar, detenerse o hacer poses finales para mantener el ritmo.  
Limita los elementos sonoros (solo viento, pasos, corte del aire, breve sonido duro de contacto y roce de la ropa), y aclara que no habrá diálogos, voces, BGM, texto, subtítulos, logos ni marcas de agua.  
Para el final, especifica “cortar en medio del movimiento” y corta manteniendo la relación actualizada delante/detrás, el tamaño de los personajes, la dirección de la mirada y el eje de desaparición del fondo, evitando un final estático antinatural.

pt.content:
A imagem de referência deve declarar explicitamente “imagem 1 como a única referência de personagem” e fixar, com prioridade máxima, rosto, olhos, íris, penteado/cor do cabelo, roupa, porte físico, silhueta e cor do personagem, mantendo a mesma pessoa em toda a obra.  
Da imagem de referência, é proibido trazer para o vídeo o fundo/quarto/móveis/pose/ângulo de câmera/framing/texto/layout da tabela de configurações.  
Liste os elementos que podem variar (expressão, olhar, boca, pose, respiração, balanço natural do cabelo/roupa) e proíba todo o resto (média de traços, mistura de características, troca de roupa, virar outra pessoa, duplicação/clonagem, personagens adicionais) para evitar deformação do personagem.  
Deixe explícito que há apenas um personagem em cena, o personagem de referência, e proíba personagens extras e duplicações para evitar variação no número de pessoas.  
Fixe o inimigo como “um único e mesmo dragão negro do céu”, mantendo ao longo de toda a obra a cor (obsidiana), as linhas luminosas (ciano fino), os olhos (dourados), a expressão/porte/contorno, e proíba transformá-lo em outra espécie, abstração ou duplicação.  
Declare que não haverá sangue, ferimentos ou amputações, para evitar conteúdo extremo e falhas visuais.  
Fixe a arma em uma única unidade, com nome incluso (AERIAL RESCUE AXE／空巡救援斧), e liste os detalhes de forma que ela se mova como uma estrutura única e consistente.  
Para evitar falhas na arma, proíba duplicação, separação, ramificação, transformação em outra arma, troca de peças, curvatura do cabo e rotação independente apenas da ponta, e instrua a manter contato entre as duas mãos e o cabo.  
Como especificação de renderização, deixe claro “contorno fino colorido + sombra cel-shading em 2 a 3 níveis + sombra intermediária com transparência” e “realces multilayer nítidos por material”, e proíba contorno preto grosso/sombra cel de camada única/rosto 3D genérico/CG plástico/fundo de baixa densidade/semi-realismo a realismo/mistura de estilos.  
Mantenha o fundo com saturação um nível abaixo da dos personagens e formalize regras de cor, como limitar o ciano do dragão a uma cor secundária, para reduzir variações cromáticas.
